Almost never on sale: Latest black Apple Magic Mouse at Prime Day low pricing, more from $60

Prime Day is still a rollin’ and so is what might be the most rare Apple deal we have tracked all year – the latest black USB-C Magic Mouse down at the $79.99 low. The white model is also at its best price with a $59.99 Prime Day deal, but discounts on the black model are about as rare as it gets.

Now sure, there are some Apple releases that are basically never on sale in new condition, typically the headliner flagship products like the latest iPhone release and the latest-generation Apple Polishing Cloth, but next to that, the black Magic Mouse is typically the only thing safe from major sale events.

However, this year…not so much. Regularly $99, Amazon has it sitting down at $79.99 shipped for just shy of 20% in savings for the first time it has been back down at all-time low pricing since, well, basically forever. It dropped this low once before now, but that was back closer to launch – it spent almost all of 2025 at full price save for a few dips down to $85. This year, it has been hovering closer to $95 right through since January.
